concept: A custom CRM as the questions only one trade asks. Each scene is one form control at enormous scale, and it works: a dog groomer's three-way choice (Bites? No, Sometimes, Yes), a cake maker's stepper (Tiers? 1, 2, 3), a removal firm's switch (Piano? Yes), then a picker wheel of other trades' questions that stops on Yours?, and one ink button: Book a call at nexulabs.co.uk. Butter yellow, ink and raised white; Fraunces for the questions, Geist for the interface.
